quizName:
Hardest Questions in Nevada
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: If you are in a serious car crash, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Stop your vehicle off the road if possible. Call 911 if anyone is hurt. You must report the crash to police if someone is injured, someone dies, or property damage is more than $1,000 (or more than $200 to government property like signs or guardrails).

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: You miss your turn or exit on a freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Make the turn quickly from your current lane.
Keep driving until the next turn, exit, or safe place to turn around.
Signal other drivers to stop so you can turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep driving until the next turn, exit, or safe place to turn around.
questions.explanation: Do not back up if you miss your turn or exit. Continue to the next turn or exit where you can safely turn around. Backing up on a freeway or shoulder is illegal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn drivers about railroad crossings ahead. Watch for trains when you see this sign.

questions.question: How can alcohol affect you while driving?
questions.explanation: Alcohol slows reaction time, coordination, and balance. It impairs judgment and makes you feel overly confident. It also reduces your vision and ability to judge distances.

questions.question: Cell phones can seriously distract drivers.
questions.explanation: Do not use cell phones, computers, or other devices while driving, except to report a crash or emergency. Keep your full attention on the road.

questions.question: Should drivers keep a safe distance from cyclists?
questions.explanation: Drivers must be careful around cyclists and maintain a safe distance from them.

questions.question: When should you slow down while driving?

options.text: When the road is wet or slippery.

questions.explanation: Slow down on narrow or winding roads, near intersections, near railroad crossings, on hills, in sharp or blind curves, near pedestrians, near hazards, and when roads are wet or slippery.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers that parking is not allowed in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is showing red.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is showing green.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there is a traffic signal at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a road crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers what they must and must not do. It means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers what to expect ahead. This sign warns drivers that cyclists may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means that action is not allowed. U-turns cannot be made where this sign is posted.

questions.question: Anything that requires you to ____ could cause you to crash.

options.text: Take your eyes off the road
Take your hands off the wheel
Take your attention away from driving

questions.explanation: A distraction is anything that takes your attention away from driving, takes your eyes off the road, or takes your hands off the wheel.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you:

options.text: May pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white and rectangular with black markings. Drivers must obey them. This sign means drivers cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: A driver's ability can be impaired by:
questions.explanation: Safe driving depends on being in good physical condition. Alcohol, drugs, and drowsiness can all impair driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to road conditions ahead. This sign means traffic is coming from both directions.

questions.question: When you see a stopped school bus with its stop arm extended, you should:

options.text: Come to a complete stop and wait.
Honk and pass the bus on the left.
Continue driving when you think kids are done exiting.
Pass the bus before its door opens.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and wait.
questions.explanation: You must come to a complete stop when a school bus has its stop arm out. Do not proceed until the arm is pulled in.

questions.question: Distracted driving can be caused by:

options.text: Talking or texting on a cell phone.
Changing a radio station or CD.

questions.explanation: Drivers must focus fully on driving. Any additional activity can distract drivers and create danger.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Do not park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action is not allowed. In this case, right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that when turning left on a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic. Complete the turn only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: When approaching railroad tracks, you should:

options.text: Look, listen, slow down, and be prepared to stop.
Speed up to cross the tracks before the gate closes.
Try to drive around a lowered gate.
Not worry about how many tracks there are.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, slow down, and be prepared to stop.
questions.explanation: Look both ways, listen for trains, slow down, and be ready to stop at railroad tracks. A train or other vehicle might be using the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop. Give the right-of-way to other traffic. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: You get angry at work. When you reach your car, you should:

options.text: Play the radio loudly to distract yourself.
Drive fast on the highway to calm down.
Take a few minutes to cool off before driving.
Stop for a few drinks before driving home.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to cool off before driving.
questions.explanation: Wait until you are calm before driving. Angry or upset drivers make poor decisions and put themselves and others at risk.

questions.question: Can drivers text while driving?

options.text: Only if you are a skilled driver.
Only if your eyes leave the road briefly.

questions.explanation: Texting while driving is illegal. You cannot use a handheld phone or device to send, read, or send messages while driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means the action is prohibited. Right turns are not permitted where this sign is posted.

questions.question: When turning or changing lanes, you must:

options.text: Always signal, even if no other cars are visible.
Signal only if you see other traffic.
Signal only when driving at night.
Signal only in heavy night traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always signal, even if no other cars are visible.
questions.explanation: Always signal when turning, changing lanes, or pulling away from the curb. Make signaling a habit, even when you do not see other traffic.

questions.question: When stopped for a traffic violation or equipment check, what must you show?
questions.explanation: You must have three documents when driving: your license, proof of registration, and proof of insurance. You must show all three if stopped.

questions.question: What should you do when you encounter an aggressive driver?

options.text: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
Cut them off to slow them down.
Make sure they know you disapprove.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
questions.explanation: Stay calm and create distance between your vehicle and theirs. Slow down and let them pass. Do not make eye contact or rude gestures.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that left turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Cars turning left on green must wait for oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cars turning left on green must wait for oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign means that left-turning traffic must yield to oncoming vehicles, even with a green light.

questions.question: What does alcohol cause?
questions.explanation: Even small amounts of alcohol hurt your vision, judgment, concentration, and coordination.

questions.question: When should you drive slower than the posted speed limit?
questions.explanation: Drive at a safe speed for the conditions. Reduce your speed on curves, in bad weather, and in heavy traffic. Always adjust your speed based on road and weather conditions.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: When should you check that your passengers have buckled their seat belts?

options.text: Only if it's raining or snowing.
When a police officer stops you.

questions.explanation: Seat belts protect you in a crash. Make sure you and all passengers are buckled in before you start driving.

questions.question: When an emergency vehicle with sirens and flashing lights approaches, you should pull to the right edge of the road and let it pass.
questions.explanation: When you see or hear an emergency vehicle with lights and/or sirens, move to the right side of the road immediately and let it pass.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction shown.
Lanes are reserved for buses and carpools.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces for people with disabled parking permits only.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings prepare you for upcoming road hazards. This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming. Be ready for red lights, yellow lights, and cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot drive into this road or driveway from your direction. Turn around and take a different route.

questions.question: Before turning, you should:
questions.explanation: Turn on your signal 3 to 4 seconds before you turn. This warns other drivers of your plan.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign shows which direction you must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to drive in your current direction.

questions.question: Orange signs are used in construction work zones.
questions.explanation: Work zone signs are usually orange and diamond-shaped. Some are rectangular. These signs are reflective so you can see them better at night.

questions.question: Who must wear a seat belt in a moving vehicle?
questions.explanation: Everyone in a moving vehicle must wear a seat belt. Children under 6 years old and those weighing less than 60 pounds must use an approved child safety seat.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings prepare you for road hazards. This sign warns you of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to protect your brakes and avoid crashes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. Wherever you see this sign, U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: You are borrowing an unfamiliar vehicle from a friend. You should:

options.text: Not worry about it because all vehicles are the same.
Not tell your friend you are unfamiliar with the vehicle.
Ignore any obvious problems to avoid embarrassing your friend.
Take a few minutes to learn where everything is and how to use all the vehicle's controls.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to learn where everything is and how to use all the vehicle's controls.
questions.explanation: Before driving an unfamiliar vehicle, spend a few minutes learning where the turn signals, hazard lights, headlights, windshield wipers, brakes, gear shift, and horn are located and how to use them. Fix any problems before driving.
